items.title: Goldman Sachs Names Top Picks in Business & Information Services Sector
items.summary: Investing.com -- Goldman Sachs has identified five leading stocks in the Americas business and information services sector, highlighting companies with strong growth momentum and expanding profit margins. The selections span uniform services, data storage, credit ratings, and professional information providers, with analysts pointing to artificial intelligence adoption and infrastructure buildout as key growth drivers across multiple names.

items.title: One of 3 ratings agencies now has XPO as investment-grade
items.summary: LTL carrier XPO is now an investment-grade credit at one of the three major ratings agencies. Fitch Ratings has upgraded its rating on XPO (NYSE: XPO) to BBB-. That is one notch above the cutoff between investment-grade and non-investment grade debt. items.title: Moody's (MCO) Tests On Chain Ratings, Is The Stock Already Expensive?
items.summary: Moody's (MCO) is pushing further into digital assets after completing a pilot with Chainlink that sent sample credit ratings across multiple blockchains using Chainlink's interoperability protocol and Moody's Token Integration Engine. Over the past month, Moody's has seen a 10.0% 30 day share price return and a 6.9% 90 day share price return. items.title: Moody's (MCO) Stock Looks Expensive On Excess Returns
items.summary: Moody's has ridden a strong multi year share price upswing, and that kind of climb naturally raises the question of whether the business is earning enough on its capital to support a valuation at this level. For anyone considering the stock today, the key issue is how closely the current price lines up with the returns the company generates on the money it invests back into the business. items.title: Moody’s Pilot With Chainlink Puts Test Ratings on Several Blockchains in One Pass
items.summary: Moody's has so far added its ratings engine one blockchain at a time. This time the companies sent the same stand-in ratings to several chains at once, a trial with no real rating actions that ran only on test networks.
